notes: Three branches, each started by وحدثنا: the text repeats names per branch, so the tail is null
The second branch (فضيل) ends at Hisham as written; Ibn Sirin is not named there
Ibn Sirin's saying (إن هذا العلم دين) is one saying; محمد in the first branch is not merged with محمد بن سيرين (rule 9)
